name: codex-context-orb
description: Local task ledgers, explicit artifact checks, as-of evidence history and metadata-only lifecycle hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Check selected artifacts and keep a sourced task ledger.
interface.longDescription: An independent companion for the Context Orb desktop app. User-requested checks record declared requirements, captured file versions and literal results with history. Restart benefit is not evaluated; automatic model review and foreground tracking are not implemented.
